declared_vs_mapped_state.note: mapped < declared is expected and behavior-preserving: yosys exploits reset-value constants (never-written high bits of peg/inc registers) and ROM-content redundancy, replacing redundant flops with wires. The contract the mapping must preserve is RTL behavior, proven bit-exact to the frozen model by tools/h06_compare.py.

full.requirement: mapped flops > 192 (six registered 32-bit phase-increment outputs are irreducible) and chip area > 0 and sequential area > 0 and cells > 0

strip_negative_control.requirement: strip-observability must make the flop gate FAIL (all state removed)

rom_representation.detail: the 1025x32 freqlut ROM and the 2048x26 LFO sine ROM dissolve to combinational gates (yosys MEMORY_MAP; no BRAM in this flow); final stat shows no memory cells
